newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 2.5 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 2.5 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 59,339 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended March 22, up 2.5 percent from the same period in 1996, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Wednesday.
The amount of weekly power supplied to the Pacific Southwest area showed the largest year-to-year rise, up 7.9 percent to 4,656 GWh, EEI said.
The Southeast region experienced the only decrease in power output, falling 2.0 percent from the corresponding period a year earlier to 13,577 GWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production for the first 12 weeks of 1997 totaled 758,097 GWh, up 0.2 percent from the same period in 1996, EEI said.
